name: Daemons, Damsels, and Mythical Milfs
source:
You play as an 18-year-old half-daemon who is forced to live away from people because your father was a member of the Order of Dusk, whose members have been plotting coups d'etat in many countries.

One day the woman who raised you, the nocturnal demon Nikta, who is also a member of the Order, comes to you and asks for help.

You must hide your demonic appearance and travel to the distant city of Kae'Thalor to help her daughter Azura with the research the Order needs. She works as a librarian for the Adventurer's Guild, so you will have to become a member of that guild as well.

You go there with your Familiar, the demonic cat Fluffy, whom you rescued a month ago. Along the way, you also meet the snow elf Countess Lyel and her bodyguard werewolf Tasha, who want to join the guild for different reasons.
translation:
你扮演一个18岁的半恶魔，被迫远离人群生活，因为你的父亲是黄昏骑士团的成员，该组织的成员一直在许多国家策划政变。

有一天，抚养你长大的女人，夜行恶魔尼克塔，也是凤凰社的一员，来到你身边寻求帮助。

你必须隐藏自己恶魔般的外表，前往遥远的凯撒洛城，帮助她的女儿阿祖拉进行凤凰社所需的研究。她是冒险家公会的图书管理员，所以你也必须成为该公会的成员。

你和你的宠物，一个月前你救下的恶魔猫毛毛一起去那里。一路上，你还遇到了雪精灵莱尔伯爵夫人和她的保镖狼人塔莎，他们出于不同的原因想要加入公会。
